title: Measles Outbreak Spreads as New York Declares Emergency
subtitle: Record-breaking cases in Pennsylvania and rising numbers in neighboring states force officials to take urgent action.

summary.en: Pennsylvania has officially surpassed 1,000 measles cases, marking its largest outbreak in over three decades. In response to the growing threat, New York Governor Kathy Hochul has declared a state of emergency. Health experts warn that low vaccination rates are the primary cause of this nationwide surge. The crisis has led to political tension regarding how to report and manage the disease. Officials are now expanding access to vaccines to help stop the spread of this highly contagious virus.
summary.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州的麻疹病例已正式突破一千例，創下三十多年來最嚴重的疫情紀錄。為應對日益嚴峻的威脅，紐約州州長凱西·霍楚宣布進入緊急狀態。衛生專家警告，疫苗接種率偏低是導致全國疫情激增的主因。這場危機已引發關於如何通報與管理該疾病的政治緊張局勢。官員們目前正擴大疫苗接種管道，以協助遏止這種高傳染性病毒的擴散。

paragraphs.en: The United States is currently facing its most difficult year for measles since 1991. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), there have been nearly 3,900 reported cases across the country this year. The situation has become particularly serious in Pennsylvania, where state health officials confirmed that the total number of cases has now surpassed 1,000. This is the largest outbreak the state has experienced in more than thirty years.
paragraphs.zh: 美國目前正面臨自一九九一年以來最艱難的麻疹疫情。根據美國疾病管制與預防中心（CDC）的數據，今年全國已通報近三千九百起病例。賓夕法尼亞州的疫情尤為嚴峻，州衛生官員證實，該州累計病例數現已突破一千大關，這是該州三十多年來最嚴重的一次疫情爆發。

paragraphs.en: As the virus continues to move across state lines, New York Governor Kathy Hochul declared a state of emergency on Monday. The Guardian reports that this decision was made in response to a sharp increase in cases within rural parts of New York and neighboring states, including Pennsylvania. The emergency order is designed to make it easier for people to get vaccinated. It allows a wider group of health professionals, such as midwives and paramedics, to give vaccines. It also allows nurses to help doctors by ordering tests for the virus.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著病毒持續跨州蔓延，紐約州州長凱西·霍楚（Kathy Hochul）於週一宣布進入緊急狀態。《衛報》（The Guardian）報導指出，此舉是為了應對紐約州農村地區及包括賓夕法尼亞州在內的鄰近州病例激增的情況。這項緊急命令旨在讓民眾更容易接種疫苗，允許更多類型的醫療專業人員（例如助產士和護理人員）協助施打疫苗，並授權護理師協助醫師開立病毒檢測單。

paragraphs.en: Measles is a highly contagious disease. It spreads easily when an infected person breathes, coughs, or sneezes. The virus can even stay in the air for up to two hours. According to the CDC, about nine out of ten people who are not protected will catch the virus if they are exposed to it. Health experts note that the country had successfully stopped the spread of measles in 2000 by keeping vaccination rates high. However, those rates have recently fallen below the 95% level needed to keep communities safe.
paragraphs.zh: 麻疹是一種傳染性極強的疾病，當感染者呼吸、咳嗽或打噴嚏時，病毒便容易傳播，且病毒在空氣中最高可存活兩小時。根據疾管中心指出，未受保護的人若接觸到病毒，約有十分之九會遭到感染。衛生專家指出，美國曾於二○○○年透過維持高疫苗接種率，成功阻斷了麻疹傳播。然而，近期的接種率已降至維持社區安全所需的百分之九十五以下。

paragraphs.en: MedPage Today reports that Pennsylvania’s outbreak began in April in areas west of Philadelphia. Since then, the state has recorded 198 hospitalizations and five deaths. Similar problems are appearing in other states like Ohio, which has seen more than 200 cases this year. In both Pennsylvania and Ohio, health officials have pointed to lower vaccination rates in certain communities, including large Amish populations, as a major factor in the spread of the disease.
paragraphs.zh: 《今日醫學》（MedPage Today）報導稱，賓夕法尼亞州的疫情始於四月，地點位於費城以西的地區。自那時起，該州已記錄到一百九十八起住院病例及五起死亡案例。類似的問題也出現在俄亥俄州等其他州，該州今年已出現超過兩百起病例。在賓夕法尼亞州與俄亥俄州，衛生官員皆指出，特定社區（包括龐大的阿米什人聚落）疫苗接種率偏低，是導致疾病擴散的主要因素。

paragraphs.en: There is also growing tension regarding how the federal government is handling the crisis. A public disagreement has broken out between Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro and U.S. Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Governor Shapiro has publicly called the Health Secretary “incompetent” regarding his response to the outbreak. The conflict centers on how the government counts deaths related to the measles virus. For several weeks, the CDC did not list any measles deaths on its public data dashboard, saying it needed more information. The agency only began adding the deaths to its official count after facing pressure.
paragraphs.zh: 聯邦政府處理此次危機的方式也引發了日益緊張的局勢。賓夕法尼亞州州長喬什·夏皮羅（Josh Shapiro）與美國衛生部長小羅伯特·甘迺迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）之間爆發了公開爭執。夏皮羅州長公開批評衛生部長在應對疫情方面「無能」。衝突的核心在於政府如何統計與麻疹病毒相關的死亡人數。疾管中心在數週內未在其公開數據儀表板上列出任何麻疹死亡病例，理由是需要更多資訊。該機構僅在面臨壓力後，才開始將死亡病例納入官方統計。

paragraphs.en: Critics argue that the rise in cases is fueled by a combination of factors, including limited access to healthcare, parental waivers that allow children to skip routine vaccines, and the spread of false information. State Senator Gustavo Rivera, who leads the health committee in the New York senate, stated that the rise in cases is a direct result of a decrease in childhood vaccinations caused by misinformation. He described the current situation as a public health emergency.
paragraphs.zh: 批評者認為，病例增加是由多種因素共同導致，包括醫療資源取得受限、允許兒童免除常規疫苗接種的家長豁免權，以及錯誤資訊的散布。紐約州參議院衛生委員會主席、州參議員古斯塔沃·里維拉（Gustavo Rivera）表示，病例增加是因錯誤資訊導致兒童疫苗接種率下降的直接後果。他將當前局勢形容為一場公共衛生緊急事件。

paragraphs.en: As the number of cases continues to climb, the pressure on health systems is increasing. In New York, there have been 108 cases this year, compared to only one case in 2023. Most of these cases occurred outside of New York City in rural areas. Governor Hochul emphasized that no one should become seriously ill or die from a disease that can be prevented by a vaccine. She stated that these new emergency measures are intended to protect residents and support local health workers who are working hard to stop the virus.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著病例數持續攀升，醫療系統面臨的壓力也隨之增加。紐約州今年已出現一百零八起病例，而二○二三年僅有一例。這些病例大多發生在紐約市以外的農村地區。霍楚州長強調，沒有人應該因為一種可以透過疫苗預防的疾病而重病或死亡。她表示，這些新的緊急措施旨在保護居民，並支持正努力遏止病毒傳播的基層醫療人員。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the situation remains uncertain. International health officials are scheduled to meet in November to discuss whether the United States and Mexico have lost their status as measles-free regions. With the virus continuing to spread, health authorities are urging the public to stay informed and ensure their vaccinations are up to date. The combination of emergency orders and increased testing is the latest attempt to bring the situation under control, but experts warn that reaching the necessary 95% vaccination rate remains the most important step to ending the outbreak.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，局勢仍充滿不確定性。國際衛生官員預計將於十一月開會，討論美國與墨西哥是否已失去「無麻疹地區」的資格。隨著病毒持續擴散，衛生當局呼籲民眾保持關注，並確保疫苗接種紀錄更新。緊急命令與擴大檢測的結合，是目前試圖控制局勢的最新嘗試，但專家警告，達到百分之九十五的必要疫苗接種率，仍是終結疫情最關鍵的步驟。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To start suddenly (used for unpleasant things like war, fire, or conflict).
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「逃脫」，這裡指衝突突然發生。文中：A public disagreement has broken out between Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro and U.S. Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To have something as the main subject or focus.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（中心），這裡作動詞片語。文中：The conflict centers on how the government counts deaths related to the measles virus.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To increase or strengthen something, especially an argument or a negative situation.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（燃料），這裡指讓負面情況更嚴重。文中：Critics argue that the rise in cases is fueled by a combination of factors, including limited access to healthcare, parental waivers that allow children to skip routine vaccines, and the spread of false information.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Modern, recent, or containing the latest information.
keyTerms.noteZh: 形容詞片語，指保持在最新狀態。文中：With the virus continuing to spread, health authorities are urging the public to stay informed and ensure their vaccinations are up to date.

quiz.question: What specific change was implemented in New York as a result of the state of emergency declaration?

options.A: The state mandated that all residents must receive a measles vaccine by the end of the month.
options.B: The scope of professionals authorized to administer vaccines was expanded.
options.C: The government closed all public schools in rural areas to prevent further transmission.
options.D: The state increased funding specifically for the Amish population to improve healthcare access.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，緊急命令明確指出「It allows a wider group of health professionals, such as midwives and paramedics, to give vaccines」，這表示擴大了能施打疫苗的專業人員範圍。選項 A 文章未提及強制接種期限。選項 C 文章提到的是增加醫療資源，而非關閉學校。選項 D 雖然文章提到 Amish 社群，但並未提及這是緊急命令的具體內容。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might the United States lose its 'measles-free' status?

options.A: Because the virus has mutated into a new strain that current vaccines cannot prevent.
options.B: Because the federal government has stopped tracking measles cases on its public dashboard.
options.C: Because vaccination rates have dropped below the threshold required to maintain herd immunity.
options.D: Because international health organizations have decided to change the definition of a measles-free region.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第三段提到，美國曾在 2000 年成功遏止麻疹，是因為維持高疫苗接種率，但目前接種率已降至 95% 以下。文章最後一段提到國際組織將評估美國是否失去「無麻疹地區」地位，推論可知這是因為接種率不足導致群體免疫失效。選項 A 文章未提及病毒變異。選項 B 雖然提到 CDC 數據爭議，但這不是失去地位的主因。選項 D 文章未提及定義變更。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the word 'fueled' mean in the context of the rise in measles cases?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在文中「the rise in cases is fueled by a combination of factors」一句中，fueled 是比喻用法，意指這些因素（如錯誤資訊、醫療取得困難等）助長或推動了病例的增加。選項 A 是字面意思，不適用於抽象的病例增長。選項 C 雖有提供資源之意，但文中是指負面因素的推波助瀾。選項 D 完全不符合語境。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding the current measles outbreak in the U.S.?

options.A: The outbreak is primarily the result of a political conflict between state and federal officials.
options.B: Measles has become a global pandemic that requires international intervention.
options.C: The U.S. is struggling with a significant measles outbreak driven by declining vaccination rates and requires urgent public health action.
options.D: The Amish population is solely responsible for the rapid spread of the disease across the country.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文全面探討了美國麻疹疫情的嚴重性、原因（接種率下降、錯誤資訊）、政府反應以及未來的挑戰，這涵蓋了文章的核心主旨。選項 A 僅是文章的一個小插曲，非主旨。選項 B 將範圍擴大至全球，文章聚焦於美國。選項 D 過度簡化，雖然提到特定群體，但文章指出這是多重因素造成的結果，而非單一族群責任。
